answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock blocks fakes. Each applicant locks 40 tokens and publishes a fingerprint of past work. Only 2 tokens return per epoch, freeing the bond after 20 epochs. A comet rush cannot cash out fast, and a tide of copies shares one fingerprint, so duplicates are flagged and frozen. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 tokens, while an honest agent pays once, keeps a copper record and earns undiluted rewards.
